newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Luxembourg funds' net assets rise by 17.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg funds' net assets rise by 17.9 pct.

text.p: Net assets held by investment funds in Luxembourg rose by 17.9 percent in 1996 to 12,449 billion Luxembourg francs, ALFI, the Luxembourg Association of Investment Funds said on Tuesday.
Of the increase 52 percent was the result of value increases due to higher markets, 48 percent resulted from new inflows.
Fixed income fund volume contracted by 1.4 percent on a December 1996 to December 1995 basis, but they still accounted for 48.8 percent of total industry assets.
Soft interest rates and stock market gains led to a 3.3 percent increase in equity fund volume, which accounted for 18.4 percent of industry assets.
Money market funds took up the remainder of the total.
Swiss sponsors remained the leading group with 31.5 percent of the Luxembourg market. Their fund assets rose by 5.7 percent.
German sponsors, losing 3.8 percent of their market share, came second.
